text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Not yet, one more 
lap...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... You have noticeably been 
overworking yourself lately.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Dwelling on previous race results... Hmm. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Quiz-Asking Student
text_block_list.text:
—Tokai Teio VS Nice Nature! Let the sudden 
quiz showdown begin!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, quite a crowd has gathered! Nice, 
nice! This is gonna be so hype!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Uhhhhh... Ikuno? What on earth is this 
quiz showdown thing???

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was concerned that continuing to push 
yourself while brooding might lead to 
injury.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I hypothesized that holding a 
contest outside of racing and getting 
revenge on Teio-san might help clear your 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's why...? Jeez... talk about 
looking out for me in the weirdest way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, let's do this, Nature! 
The ultimate, invincible Teio-sama is 
totally gonna win at trivia too~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio... you entertainment-loving freak! 
You're completely fired up for this, 
aren't you...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Gaaah!! Fine!! If it's come to this, 
guess I have no choice!

text_block_list.name: Quiz-Asking Student
text_block_list.text:
Now then, on to Question 1! The 
traditional Japanese undergarment covering 
from the waist down to the ankles is—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —"Momohiki"!
(Ding-dong!)

text_block_list.name: Quiz-Asking Student
text_block_list.text:
Correct! Nice Nature takes the early lead! 
Moving on to Question 2—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—"Counting one's chickens before they 
hatch"! And the next one is 
"Keyhole-shaped tumulus"!
(Ding-dong ding-dong!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not bad, Nature! I can't afford to 
lose either!

In the early stages of the quiz showdown, 
Nice Nature took the lead. However—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—I got it! The answer is "Girls Spreading 
Their Wings"!
(Ding-dong ding-dong!)

text_block_list.name: Quiz-Asking Student
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Tokai Teio! That makes 5 
correct answers in a row!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, how's that! I'm gonna pull off a 
massive comeback from here~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, are you serious...!? Catching up 
from a gap like that!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...She really does sparkle. Just as I 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I was definitely in peak form today. 
And yet, I lost to Teio again...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... Damn it all...!! It's so 
frustrating...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Idiot! If I back down here, all that's 
waiting for me is... more regret!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet, it starts here! The 
answers are— "Sankin-kotai"! "Pit viper"! 
"Rakugo storyteller"!

Tokai Teio VS Nice Nature. The result of 
this fiercely contested quiz showdown, 
where neither gave an inch, is—

text_block_list.name: Quiz-Asking Student
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! By a margin of just one 
question, Nice Nature takes the victory!
(Woooooooow!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I won. Against Teio... I won!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~! So close! That's so 
frustrating~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...But I won't lose next time, Nature! 
Because I'm never giving up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~!? Are you seriously rocking that 
undaunted protagonist spirit even now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Sheesh, seriously. You're way too 
dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... regardless, Nature-san. You 
achieved your revenge against Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ikuno... Yeah, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... even though I won this time, that 
frustrating feeling hasn't gone away.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I—after all, I want to beat Teio in a 
race...!!
